descriptions.F2P::presentation::inverted_lightness_to: Toggling invertedLightness swaps --maxL and --minL CSS background gradient stops on the shadow presentation picker element.
descriptions.F2P::rotary::reversing_at_max_boundary_h: Reversing rotary direction immediately reduces saturation without an accumulated angular dead zone when at maximum saturation boundary.
descriptions.F2P::rotary::reversing_at_min_boundary_h: Reversing rotary direction immediately increases saturation without an accumulated angular dead zone when at minimum saturation boundary.
descriptions.F2P::rotary::shift_key_toggle_mid_gestur: Pressing or releasing the Shift modifier mid-gesture scales subsequent angular sensitivity without causing discontinuities or value jumps.
descriptions.F2P::event::zero_displacement_or_zero_an: Interactions resulting in zero coordinate displacement or zero angular delta do not emit poline-change events.
descriptions.F2P::lifecycle::active_pointer_exclusivi: Active pointer gestures maintain exclusive ownership; secondary pointer events do not mutate palette data, alter capture, or clear the active gesture.
descriptions.F2P::lifecycle::pointercancel_terminates: Receiving pointercancel terminates the active interaction, cleans transient interaction classes, releases capture, and ignores subsequent stale events.
descriptions.F2P::lifecycle::disconnect_cleans_classe: Disconnecting the picker element from the DOM clears transient ring-hover and ring-adjusting CSS classes and terminates ongoing gestures.
descriptions.F2P::lifecycle::reconnect_restores_clean: Reconnecting the picker restores interactive functionality cleanly without lingering listeners or duplicate change event dispatches.
descriptions.F2P::lifecycle::lostpointercapture_termi: Losing capture for the active pointer terminates anchor and rotary gestures without changing palette data or dispatching an event, while capture loss for another pointer leaves the active gesture intact.
descriptions.F2P::lifecycle::setpoline_during_active_: Replacing the palette with setPoline during an active anchor drag or rotary adjustment cancels the gesture, clears visual state, releases pointer capture, and prevents stale pointer events from mutating data or dispatching changes.
descriptions.F2P::lifecycle::reentrant_change_callbac: Synchronous poline-change callbacks that replace the palette or disconnect the picker cannot restore pointer ownership, capture, gesture state, or stale mutations after the callback returns.
descriptions.F2P::lifecycle::retired_surfaces_cannot_: A presentation surface that is no longer bound cannot mutate the palette, emit changes, acquire capture, alter interaction classes, or interfere with ongoing or subsequent gestures using the same pointerId on the current surface.
descriptions.F2P::lifecycle::same_palette_reassignmen: Calling setPoline with the already attached Poline instance still invalidates the active gesture, releases capture, clears transient state, emits no change event, and leaves the picker ready for a fresh gesture.
descriptions.F2P::lifecycle::reentrant_refresh_cannot: A synchronous change listener that refreshes the picker invalidates the emitting gesture, and the outer operation cannot restore pointer ownership, capture, transient classes, or stale mutations after the listener returns.
descriptions.F2P::lifecycle::reentrant_replacement_ca: A change listener may replace the palette and begin a fresh gesture on the current presentation; completion of the older emitting operation cannot overwrite or cancel the newer gesture.
descriptions.F2P::lifecycle::setallowaddpoints_preser: Calling setAllowAddPoints mid-gesture or during synchronous change re-entry preserves the active gesture, maintains pointer capture, and allows subsequent move and up events to update the palette normally without emitting spurious changes.
descriptions.F2P::lifecycle::normal_updatesvg_preserv: Direct programmatic calls to updateSVG during an active drag or rotary adjustment preserve the gesture, maintain capture and interaction styles, and emit no change events.
descriptions.F2P::lifecycle::addpointatposition_gestu: Programmatically calling addPointAtPosition during an active gesture preserves the ongoing interaction while emitting a change event for the added point; calling it within synchronous change re-entry cancels the emitting gesture and invalidates subsequent stale pointer events.
descriptions.F2P::event::pointerdown_propagation_bran: Pointerdown events on interactive surfaces are intercepted via stopPropagation across core hits, ring hits, empty canvas clicks, secondary pointers, and uninitialized palettes, while non-interactive surfaces permit natural event bubbling.
descriptions.F2P::architecture::presentation_interact: Presentation and pointer interaction must be owned by distinct internal collaborators and coordinated through PolinePicker. Collaborators may be implemented as classes, objects, or closure-based units and may be declared in the same source file, provided responsibilities are genuinely separated and delegated by PolinePicker.
descriptions.F2P::coordinates::svg_content_box_conten: Programmatic coordinates use the SVG content box with padding, border and nonzero viewport offset; no pre-clamp before Poline handles out-of-range input.

descriptions.F2P::coordinates::svg_content_box_border: Programmatic coordinates use the SVG content box with padding, border and nonzero viewport offset; no pre-clamp before Poline handles out-of-range input.

descriptions.F2P::interaction::canvas_click_with_allo: With allow-add-points, a pointerdown on empty presentation space adds one anchor at the converted position, dispatches one poline-change, captures the pointer, and continues the same gesture as an anchor drag that preserves z; pointerup releases capture.
